planner.question: Can affine selector reparametrization preserve ordinary SAT decision and eliminate free selector dimensions with a charged structural parameter?
planner.strategy: Use affine codimension, column spans and exact syndrome reachability over source-variable choices.
planner.alternative: Reduce 3SAT to disjoint narrow parity equations and test a dual CNF characterization.
planner.stop_rule: Do not claim a universal low-rank representation, or equate FPT feasibility with polynomial general SAT.
literature_leads: Previous MathOS universal selector, affine selector rigidity and programmable parity; elementary binary linear algebra and finite-state DP. No novelty claim.

construct.claim: Affine selector feasibility admits exact witness-preserving deterministic 2^r poly(L) time and space at codimension r, with an equivalent dual CNF.
construct.scope: Explicit clause list, binary selector equations and source variables, independent rows after elimination; ordinary existential decision.
construct.derivation: Satisfied columns form a sum of per-variable sign spans; maintain exact union of syndrome sums, recording predecessor and column provenance; dual annihilator tests are clauses.
unresolved_steps: Efficient universal codimension reduction or stronger structural transfer.
candidate_tests: Exhaust small matrices and RHS values; replay selector/source witnesses and dual clauses.

alternative.claim: Affine selector feasibility is NP-complete even for disjoint independent parity rows of width at most three, all RHS bits one.
alternative.scope: Full normalized universal width-three pool; fresh clause guards; all other selector bits unrestricted.
alternative.derivation: Pin each guard false and require odd parity of its tagged literal selectors; exact bidirectional reduction from 3SAT.
unresolved_steps: Any general polynomial preprocessing to low codimension would imply P=NP; no unrestricted lower bound.
candidate_tests: All small source formula subsets, actual tagged clause constraints and bounded DP reconstruction.

objections: Replacing union by span mixes incompatible source signs.
Dual CNF construction alone does not solve its satisfiability.
NP-completeness does not prove P!=NP; disjoint rows may have large rank.
counterexample_candidates: Opposite signed unit columns with independent syndromes: their sum is linearly reachable but not SAT reachable.
Tagged clause reduction has disjoint rows yet represents arbitrary 3SAT.
critic.equivalence_audit: Exact rank reduction, one truth value per source variable, XOR provenance, dual annihilator equivalence and decision-preserving reduction.
critic.barrier_audit: No unrestricted deterministic lower bound or P versus NP resolution.
